description: Labelled traffic profiles for the honeypot dataset release. Each profile mirrors the style of configs/attack_profiles.json but adds a ground-truth category/label, randomised credentials, and optional steps so sessions are not near-duplicates. Steps: a command string, a list of alternatives (one is chosen), or {"p": probability, "cmd": ...} for an optional step. {placeholders} are filled from the pools below; held_out profiles are kept out of the DEC training set to test novelty detection.

profiles.name: brute_force
profiles.description: Credential guessing with several failed logins, then a short check or disconnect.
